title: Three Helpers
goal: Claude reads big projects. Cursor edits files fast. Gemini knows lots. Pick the right helper for the job!
mascot_lines: Claude is the BIG-PICTURE robot. Great for plans and reading lots.
Cursor is the FAST-EDIT robot. Great for fixing one line.
Gemini knows LOTS. Great for facts and pictures.
Try asking each one the same question — see how the answers differ!

sandbox.hint: Try 'make me a story' on each helper. Notice how each replies in its own way.

payload.prompt: Match the job to the helper.
